changelog: NexVR Engine Beta 1 Release Candidate v0.1.90
features: Beta 1 Candidate Distribution: Bundled with complete standalone NSIS installer, portable binaries, and one-click diagnostic reporting for external gamer beta testing
Camera Lock Hysteresis & Anti-Snap: Retains validated orthonormal camera view transforms during stationary or slow movement periods, preventing violent 3D/2D projection snapping and flickering

Pristine Perspective Projection Fallback: Replaces uninitialized stack matrices and errant shadow cascade bindings with clean 16:9 reverse-Z perspective fallbacks, eliminating geometry stretching and zoom glitches

Compositor VSync Decoupling: Automatically overrides desktop swapchain presentation to SyncInterval = 0 when VR presentation is active, eliminating 60 Hz desktop v-blank compositor stutter on 90/120 Hz headsets

Universal 1:1 Desktop Color & Contrast Transfer: Guarantees srgbCorrection is active across all injected games, achieving exact pow(c, 2.2f) transfer curve cancellation with the OpenXR display compositor to reproduce true desktop black levels and vibrant colors

Automatic sRGB Config Healing: Automatically detects and migrates legacy vrinject.json files with srgbCorrection: false to true across game directories on read and injection deployment, permanently preventing lifted shadows and pale green fog

Pristine Local Profile Precedence: Ensures local repository and verified profiles take absolute priority over stale OTA cached profiles, preventing outdated caches from contaminating custom or newly added titles

Universal sRGB Linearization: Enabled sRGB transfer correction by default across the entire engine, launcher, and all 14 game profiles, permanently eliminating double-gamma washed out milky grays across all games

Aspect Ratio Preserving VR Projection: Dynamically normalizes OpenXR per-eye FOV to match the 16:9 game buffer, eliminating vertical stretching, horizontal squashing, and incorrect focal zooming in Mortal Shell and all flat-to-VR games
fixes: Fixed violent camera flickering and zooming in Mortal Shell by implementing camera tracker hysteresis and preventing premature lock drops on zero mouse input
Fixed SteamVR GPU performance graph purple spike wall by decoupling desktop 60 Hz VSync from 90 Hz OpenXR render loop
Fixed projection matrix stack garbage causing invalid matrix inversion in reprojection compute shaders
Fixed newly re-downloaded games re-experiencing previously debugged brightness issues caused by hardcoded 1.15 brightness in C++ config_manager.cpp and stale AppData profiles
Fixed stale profiles lingering indefinitely in AppData updates/profiles by including them in automated OTA cache cleanup
Fixed VR view appearing slightly brighter and washed out compared to desktop by replacing piecewise toe with exact 2.2 display gamma cancellation
Fixed missing compute shader sampler binding in StereoRenderer by allocating an explicit D3D11_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR sampler in StereoResourceManager
